title: Abbas Qatl Ho Gae Mehshar Bapaa Huwa
body:
ABBAS QATL HO GAE MEHSHAR BAPAA HUWA
BEKAS HUSAIN HO GAE BHAAI JUDA HUWA
AB KHATM HAI LADAAEE ALAMDAR MAR GAYA
BEKAS HUSAIN HO GAE BHAI JUDA HUWA
KYU AANKH KHOL KE HAME TUM DEKHTE NAHI
BOLE HUSAIN TEER HAI MAULA LAGAA HUWA
PYAASI SAKINA SE MAY BOHOT SHARM SAAR HOO
AFSOS WAYEDA NA YE MUJHSE WAFAA HUWA
SHAANE QALAM HAI SHER HAI ZAKHMI PADA HUWA
DAUDE HUSAIN KEHTE HUWE HAAE KYA HUWA
